bottleneck.name: Memory-level parallelism
bottleneck.detail: Waiting for a free MSHR costs 90% of cycles: the misses are independent but too few can be in flight at once.
bottleneck.suggestions: Increase cpu.mshrs; Reduce memory.latency_cycles to shorten MSHR occupancy; Improve locality so fewer misses need to be tracked

bottleneck.name: Compute
bottleneck.detail: Memory stalls account for only 1% of cycles; the machine is limited by instruction issue.
bottleneck.suggestions: Increase cpu.issue_width; Reduce the instruction count (vectorise the inner loop)
